features.name: Cell/Pack Voltage Measurement
features.description: Acquisition of individual cell voltages and pack/string voltages via AFE drivers
features.safety_relevance: high - SOA monitoring, balancing, state estimation
features.as_is_evidence: Full driver implementations for all AFE variants; cyclic CAN TX callbacks; plausibility module
gaps: No explicit worst-case timing analysis for AFE readout cycle
Diagnostic coverage for AFE communication not quantified

features.name: Temperature Measurement
features.description: Acquisition of cell/module temperatures via AFE GPIO and external NTC sensors
hardware_dependencies: External NTC sensors (EPCOS, Murata, Semitec, TDK, Vishay)
supported_variants: External NTC: EPCOS B57251/B57332/B57861, Murata NCXXXXH103, Semitec 103JT, TDK NTCG163/NTCGS103, Vishay NTCA/NTcle
key_functions: AFE GPIO voltage readout for internal temp sensors
External NTC via lookup-table or polynomial
features.safety_relevance: high - SOA monitoring, thermal management, balancing
features.as_is_evidence: TS driver with multiple sensor families; lookup-table and polynomial variants; AFE temperature readout; cyclic CAN TX
gaps: No explicit sensor calibration procedure documented
Thermal model for cell-to-sensor gradient not specified

features.name: Current Measurement
features.description: Pack current measurement via external current sensors (shunt, Hall effect)
key_functions: CAN RX callbacks for current sensor messages
features.safety_relevance: high - SOA monitoring, SOC estimation, power limits
features.as_is_evidence: CAN RX handlers for 3 current sensor types; diagnostic callbacks; power measurement in diag
gaps: Current sensor accuracy/offset calibration not in source

features.name: Measurement Plausibility Checks
features.description: Cross-checks and plausibility validation for voltage, current, temperature measurements
features.safety_relevance: high - detects sensor/AFE faults before SOA violation
features.as_is_evidence: plausibility.c/h with multiple checks; AFE plausibility API; config headers for thresholds
gaps: Plausibility thresholds not tied to specific hardware tolerances

features.name: Safe Operating Area Monitoring
features.description: Continuous monitoring of voltage, current, temperature against configured limits with graduated response
key_functions: Graduated response: warning -> derating -> contactor open
features.as_is_evidence: soa.c/h with limit checking; config for limits; diagnostic callbacks feed measurements; contactor control integration
gaps: Limit hysteresis/debounce parameters configurable but not analyzed
Common-cause failure between measurement and SOA not addressed

features.name: Cell Balancing
features.description: Passive cell balancing during charge with voltage-based and history-based strategies
supported_variants: All AFE variants with balancing support
key_functions: History-based balancing (tracks balancing time per cell)
features.as_is_evidence: bal.c/h with state machine; 3 strategies; AFE balancing commands; config for thresholds
gaps: Thermal model for balancing current not in source

features.name: State-of-Charge Estimation
features.description: SOC estimation via coulomb counting with OCV lookup-table correction
features.as_is_evidence: soc_counting.c, soc_lookup-table.c, soc_debug.c; state_estimation.c orchestrates
gaps: No temperature compensation in counting method

features.name: State-of-Energy Estimation
features.description: SOE estimation based on SOC and voltage/power integration
features.as_is_evidence: soe_counting.c, soe_debug.c

features.name: State-of-Function / Power Estimation
features.description: Maximum available charge/discharge power estimation (trapezoid method)
features.hardware_dependencies: Current sensor, voltage measurement, temperature, SOC
key_functions: Power limit calculation from SOA limits
features.safety_relevance: high - prevents SOA violation during high-power demand
features.as_is_evidence: sof_trapezoid.c/h with multi-limit calculation; config for parameters
gaps: Validation against cell datasheet not in source

features.name: State-of-Health Estimation
features.description: SOH estimation - only debug placeholder implemented
features.as_is_evidence: soh_debug.c, soh_none.c - no production algorithm
gaps: FRAM storage for aging data not utilized

features.name: Precharge and Contactor Control
features.description: High-voltage contactor state machine with precharge sequence, feedback monitoring, and fault response
key_functions: Contactor state machine (open -> precharge -> close -> hold)
features.as_is_evidence: contactor.c/h with state machine; BMS integration; diagnostic callbacks; SBC driver for drive
gaps: Precharge timing not formally verified for all contactor types

features.name: Contactor Diagnostics
features.description: Contactor weld detection, stuck-open detection, cycle counting
key_functions: Weld detection (feedback closed when commanded open)
Stuck-open detection (feedback open when commanded closed)
features.as_is_evidence: contactor.c feedback monitoring; diag_cbs_contactor.c; FRAM storage

features.name: Insulation Monitoring
features.description: HV insulation resistance monitoring via Bender IMD (ISO165C, IR155)
key_functions: CAN async TX for IMD requests
features.as_is_evidence: imd.c/h with variant support; bender_iso165c.c, bender_ir155.c; CAN TX async; diag callback
gaps: IR155 SPI fault modes not fully covered

features.name: Interlock Monitoring
features.description: High-voltage interlock loop monitoring (service disconnect, hood, crash)
features.as_is_evidence: interlock.c/h; diag_cbs_interlock.c

features.name: CAN Communication
features.description: CAN bus communication for BMS data exchange, diagnostics, and external interface
key_functions: Cyclic TX: cell voltages, temperatures, pack state, SOE, SOF, SOA, BMS state
Async TX: debug, crash dump, fatal error, IMD requests
RX: AFE data, current sensor, IMD response, debug requests, BMS state request
Message multiplexing for large data sets
features.safety_relevance: high - safety data exchange, vehicle integration
features.as_is_evidence: Full CAN driver; 30+ TX cyclic messages; 10+ RX handlers; config for message definitions
gaps: CAN bus-off recovery timing not bounded

features.name: Ethernet Communication
features.description: Ethernet/TCP communication via FreeRTOS+TCP for diagnostics, data logging, HMI
features.as_is_evidence: ethernet.c/h, ethernet_freertos.c/h; DP83869 PHY driver; EMAC driver

features.name: Watchdog Supervision
features.description: External watchdog via SBC (FS85xx) and internal CPU watchdog
key_functions: SBC external watchdog configuration and servicing
features.as_is_evidence: sbc_fs8x.c watchdog functions; sys_mon.c task monitoring; OS task hooks
gaps: Independent watchdog vs QM watchdog separation not evident

features.name: Fault Management and Error Handling
features.description: Centralized diagnostic framework with callback-based fault detection, classification, and response
features.as_is_evidence: diag.c/h framework; 30+ diag_cbs_*.c files; FRAM storage; BMS state machine integration
gaps: Fault tree analysis not in source

features.name: Event/Data Logging
features.description: FRAM-based non-volatile logging of faults, events, and operational data
features.as_is_evidence: fram.c/h; diag FRAM functions; contactor cycle count

features.name: Calibration and Configuration Management
features.description: Configuration headers for all modules, battery-specific parameters, calibration data
features.supported_variants: Per-battery configuration via conf/bms/bms.json and *_cfg.h files
key_functions: Battery cell parameters (capacity, voltage limits, temp limits, R/C)
features.as_is_evidence: Extensive *_cfg.c/h files; bms.json; HALCoGen config (.hcg/.dil)

features.name: Measurement Redundancy
features.description: Redundant measurement comparison for safety-critical signals
features.as_is_evidence: redundancy.c/h framework exists
gaps: No hardware redundancy in default configurations

features.name: Bootloader with Firmware Update
features.description: CAN-based bootloader for firmware update with CRC verification
features.as_is_evidence: bootloader/engine/boot.c; CAN callbacks; flash.c; CRC64 vendor code
gaps: Update process not fail-safe (power loss during flash)
